mapper.sql: id, title, normalized_title, fingerprint, answer, difficulty, category_id, CAST(tag_ids AS CHAR) AS tag_ids_json, direction, source_session_id, source_message_id, duplicate_count, status, error_message, question_id, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ai_question_candidate ( title, normalized_title, fingerprint, direction, source_session_id, source_message_id, status ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{normalizedTitle}, #{fingerprint}, #{direction}, #{sourceSessionId}, #{sourceMessageId}, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_question_candidate SET duplicate_count = duplicate_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE fingerprint = #{fingerprint}

UPDATE ai_question_candidate SET answer = #{answer}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, category_id = #{categoryId}, tag_ids = CAST(#{tagIdsJson} AS JSON), status = 1, error_message = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE ai_question_candidate SET status = 4, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM ai_question_candidate
ORDER BY duplicate_count DESC, create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{query.pageSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_question_candidate SET status = 5, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (1, 4)
UPDATE ai_question_candidate SET status = 2, question_id = #{questionId}, error_message = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 5
UPDATE ai_question_candidate SET status = 3, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (0, 1, 4)
